name: 胡(هو / who) are you? Slavs and Tatars
description: The collective Slavs and Tatars explores the lands east of the former Berlin Wall and west of the Great Wall of China through their characteristic blend of exhibitions, books, and lecture-performances. The group investigates the allegiances, languages, and populations of Central Asia and the Caucasus in constant transition, offering a critical lens on this geopolitical and cultural crossroads.
